text: I feel a sense of curiosity and possibility here. The glass walls and geometric lines evoke transparency and modernity, while the display inside speaks to the celebration of research and development. R+D—two symbols that embody the ever-present drive for innovation. As I step inside and witness the exhibits up close, I am aware of being part of an ongoing human project: to know more, to connect ideas, to push boundaries. I feel the quiet energy of discovery humming in the air.
